stock.description: C-MER Medical Holdings Limited specializes in offering both medical treatments and therapeutic services for a variety of eye conditions. Its business activities are segmented into two primary areas: the delivery of ophthalmological services and the retail of vision-enhancing products. Established by Shun Chiu Lam on February 1, 2016, the organization's corporate headquarters are situated in Hong Kong.
